bootnext.description: Boot entry number (e.g., '0001') to use for next boot only (sets BootNext). Empty string to clear.

delete_bootorder.description: If true, delete the BootOrder variable (--delete-bootorder).

delete_timeout.description: If true, delete the Timeout variable (--delete-timeout).

edd.description: Force EDD version ('1' or '3') for legacy systems. Deprecated; use '--full-dev-path' instead.

entries.description: List of boot entry definitions. Each item configures a specific BootXXXX entry. Use 'create', 'delete', or 'state' to modify entries.

entries.items.cmdline.description: Kernel command line arguments (ASCII or Unicode depending on 'unicode' flag).

entries.items.create.description: If true, create this entry with provided parameters.

entries.items.disk.description: Disk device (e.g., /dev/sda) where the loader resides.

entries.items.interface.description: Network interface name (e.g., eth0) — required only for netboot entries.

entries.items.label.description: Human-readable label for the boot entry (displayed in UEFI menu).

entries.items.loader.description: Relative path to the UEFI executable (e.g., \EFI\debian\grub.efi).

entries.items.number.description: Boot entry number (0x0000 - 0xFFFF). Used to identify the entry.

entries.items.state.description: Set to 'active' or 'inactive' to change the entry's active state. Omit to leave unchanged.

file_dev_path.description: Use File()-based abbreviated path for new entries (--file-dev-path).

full_dev_path.description: Use full UEFI device path for new entries (--full-dev-path).

gpt.description: Force invalid PMBR disk to be treated as GPT (--gpt).

mirror_above_4g.description: Percentage of memory to mirror above 4GB (e.g., '10.0') (--mirror-above-4G).

no_reconnect.description: Disable device reconnection after driver load (--do-not-reconnect).

order.description: List of boot entry numbers (in hex string or integer form) specifying boot order. Each value must be a valid BootXXXX entry.

reconnect.description: Enable device reconnection after driver load (--reconnect).

remove_duplicates.description: If true, run efibootmgr -D to remove duplicate entries from BootOrder.

timeout.description: UEFI Boot Manager timeout in seconds (0-65535). Must be a non-negative integer.

write_signature.description: Write unique MBR signature if needed (--write-signature).
